args.body: Problem with the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14. A catalog check shows 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222) were increased too, though they were meant to be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the higher prices, an overcharge of 4,128.60. Proposed fix: I revert the 22 prices to their pre-increase values, and someone corrects or credits the 8 orders. I have not changed anything yet. Please confirm the revert, and say who owns the order corrections.
